presentation.summary: Coordinate contractor work when permits, simultaneous activities and site conditions change.
presentation.situation: Two contractor crews are preparing different maintenance jobs in the same operating area. Their permits were issued separately and the work boundaries now overlap.
presentation.objective: Make five professional safety decisions as conditions change.
knownFacts: Two contractor crews are preparing different maintenance jobs in the same operating area. Their permits were issued separately and the work boundaries now overlap.

work_authorization_record.title: Permit Interface Review
work_authorization_record.summary: The permit review confirms that two separately authorized jobs now occupy overlapping work areas.
details: Both permits were issued for different maintenance tasks before the overlap developed.
The work boundaries intersect and the crews share access through the same operating area.
Any continuation depends on the permit scopes, responsible persons and interfaces remaining coordinated.

control_verification_record.title: Shared Isolation and Access Check
control_verification_record.summary: The interface review identifies a shared access route and a common isolation boundary affecting both crews.
details: Both contractor teams depend on the same access route to reach their work locations.
A common isolation boundary means one crew's actions can affect the protection relied on by the other.
The record identifies the interface responsibilities that must remain understood by both supervisors and crews.

condition_change_record.title: Additional Activity Change Record
condition_change_record.summary: A third maintenance activity has been introduced after the original two jobs were already underway.
details: The new activity adds another crew, work scope and set of interactions to the operating area.
The original permit-interface review did not include this third activity.
The combined work picture must now account for changed access, isolation and simultaneous-operation conflicts.

response_record.title: Boundary Deviation Record
response_record.summary: A contractor has moved outside the agreed work boundary and obstructed the shared access route.
details: The deviation places work outside the coordinated area that was reviewed with both crews.
The shared access route is no longer available as planned, affecting the other contractor activity.
The record captures the deviation so the failed control and conditions for safe restart can be addressed.

closeout_record.title: Permit Handover and Closeout Record
closeout_record.summary: Both contractor tasks are physically complete, but the operating area still requires formal handback.
details: Permit status, isolations and temporary controls must be reconciled against the completed work.
The final area condition must confirm that tools, barriers and temporary arrangements no longer affect operations.
Normal operation should rely on a documented handback rather than physical work completion alone.

safe_completion.narrative: The work is completed with controls verified.
safe_completion.keyTurningPoint: The key controls were verified before work continued.

controlled_recovery.title: Controlled recovery
controlled_recovery.narrative: Earlier gaps are recognized and corrected before completion.
controlled_recovery.keyTurningPoint: The team recovered by restoring the control boundary.

major_incident.title: Major incident
major_incident.narrative: Unresolved control gaps lead to a significant modeled outcome.
major_incident.keyTurningPoint: Work continued before the required controls were verified.
